value.rationale: The layer b-a=r-1 is geometrically natural: it is the first terminal layer adjacent to the canonical/non-terminal wall. Anticanonical quasismoothness is the entry condition for constructing well-behaved Calabi--Yau-type hypersurfaces in these singular toric ambients. The theorem turns a coordinate-subset quasismoothness test into an exact all-dimensional divisor law and proves that admissible members are cumulatively sparse with an explicit main term and constant. This is a structural and enumerative statement, not a finite table recomputation.
